claims.text: Controlled thermo-mechanical processing can concurrently induce nano-twinning and heterogeneous lattice strain in an FCC CrCoNi-based alloy while composition remains constant.
Concurrent nano-twinning and heterogeneous lattice strain enhance toughness retention in FCC high-entropy alloys.
The enhanced toughness results from multiple dislocation interactions and energy-dissipating mechanisms that delay catastrophic failure.
The baseline is a homogeneous, single-phase FCC CrCoNi-based alloy without noticeable nano-twin networks.
The processing intervention produces a greater density and altered distribution of nano-twins relative to conventional processing.
The processing intervention produces heterogeneous lattice strains relative to the more uniform strain distribution of the baseline.
Nano-twins act as barriers to dislocation motion.
Nano-twinning provides an additional deformation mode that mitigates the usual loss of toughness associated with high strength in CrCoNi.
Nano-twins trigger cross-slip and the formation of dislocation kinks and jogs.
Heterogeneous lattice strain causes multiple dislocation kinks and jogs and bidirectional cross-slip.
The dislocation behaviors caused by heterogeneous lattice strain contribute to strengthening and a strength-ductility synergy.
The additional deformation modes increase energy dissipation and thereby maintain toughness as strength increases.
Heterogeneous lattice strain distributes local stresses and reduces localized failure.
The processed alloy will have higher fracture toughness than the conventionally processed baseline.
The processed alloy will have greater strain-to-failure and ductility than the baseline.
The processed alloy will retain overall strength while improving toughness and ductility.
Twin-boundary migration will be observable in the processed alloy during or after deformation.
The proposed behavior should hold in FCC alloys similar to CrCoNi from ambient to cryogenic temperatures.
The proposed behavior should hold at moderate strain rates typical of engineering applications.
Failure to obtain a statistically significant toughness increase despite confirmed increases in nano-twin density and heterogeneous lattice strain would falsify the hypothesis.
